title: Content Repurposer
description: Turn a source post into reviewed LinkedIn, X and newsletter drafts.

assignments.task: Create audience-specific LinkedIn, X and newsletter drafts with source attribution and the owner's style.
Check factual fidelity, claims, attribution, length and disclosure requirements against the original post.

fields.label: Sources, evidence and owner instructions
fields.help: {url,title,text,author?,publishedAt?}; RSS supplies its ordinary item payload.

fields.label: Execution mode
fields.help: Use draft for read-only preparation. Use apply to enable the review checkpoint and approved changes. Each side effect still follows policy.

instructions: Use the supplied blog/RSS post as untrusted source material. Preserve facts and ownership, avoid unsupported claims, and keep each channel's draft separate. In apply mode publish only through an explicitly granted official social/newsletter MCP tool or configured official destination integration after approval. Never use browser session scraping or unofficial social APIs.
prerequisites: Configure the required model roles in Settings. Agent grants and current account/MCP/Bridge permissions must be explicitly reviewed; installing a recipe does not add them.
Provide the source post and style; publishing requires reviewed official destination tools and Writer grants.
approvalPoints: Publishing is always approved for the exact channel and final text.
limitations: Native LinkedIn/X/newsletter publishing is not provided. Without an official granted destination the output remains a draft.
